The 6/7 pair is highly temperature-sensitive, so revert to 40 C while keeping the shorter 14 min gradient to see if we can retain full resolution and still bring the last peak near or below 10 min. This isolates whether the loss came mainly from temperature rather than slope.

The critical pair improved when phi1 was lowered, suggesting selectivity benefits from a narrower, shallower window. Lower phi1 one more step to test whether the 6/7 pair reaches full credit while keeping the last peak just within 10 min.
